Small Business Bundle and seat/credit pricing: packaging, not capabilities
Consulting, onboarding, training and migration services: services, not software
HubSpot Academy, Community and partner (Solutions Partner) programme: not product capabilities
Legacy pricing models and legacy (pre-2024) editions
HubSpot Capital financing (powered by Stripe): financing offer, not a software capability
Clearbit/Breeze Intelligence as a separate brand: covered only as data-enrichment and buyer-intent rows

extraction.note: Core CRM records, properties, associations, activities, files and conversations are readable by UI export and REST APIs, but the account backup excludes associations and activity data, property history is capped at 45 (contacts) or 20 (other objects) revisions, and workflow exports omit history and email data. Deltas are available via search filters on lastmodifieddate/hs_lastmodifieddate, webhooks (creation, deletion, merge, restore, propertyChange, associationChange) and a webhooks journal holding the past three days of events.

exportOptions.name: Export records
exportOptions.description: Exports records (appointments, calls, contacts, companies, courses, custom objects, deals, listings, marketing events, payments, tickets) with current property values and associations (up to 1,000 associated record IDs per association column plus the associated record name); by default only properties in the current view.
exportOptions.limits: Up to 3 simultaneous exports and 300 per rolling 24 hours; CSV/XLSX over 1,000,000 rows delivered as multiple files in a zip; XLS limited to 65,535 rows and 256 columns, XLSX 16,384 columns; CSV zipped above 2MB; download link emailed, expires after 30 days; export permissions required.

exportOptions.name: Backup & Restore (CRM data backup)
exportOptions.description: Account backup of records and property values for contacts, companies, deals, tickets, custom objects, products, calls, conversations and tasks; a .zip with one CSV per object. Associations and activity data aren't included; sensitive-data property values are included.
exportOptions.limits: Once per week on Starter or Professional; once every 24 hours on Enterprise; recurring scheduled backups (weekly or every two weeks) Enterprise only; Super Admin required; download within 14 days; changes made while processing may be missing.
exportOptions.lowestTier: Starter (Marketing, Sales, Service, Data or Content Hub)

exportOptions.name: Export property history
exportOptions.description: Per-property export of current and historical values with change timestamps (UTC), optionally with source information (which user or tool made the change); only records that had or have a value for the property.
formats: unknown (a file format is chosen in the dialog)
exportOptions.limits: Revision history is capped: contact properties up to 45 revisions; company, deal, ticket and custom object properties up to 20 revisions. Requires CRM Export and [Object] Edit All permissions; link delivered by email.

exportOptions.name: Export properties

exportOptions.name: Files tool export

exportOptions.name: Other per-tool exports (hub page)

exportOptions.limits: Page states there is no way to merge all the data between HubSpot accounts; the way to move assets is export then import or recreate.

apis.name: Exports API (/crm/exports/2026-09/export/async)
apis.description: Async export of an object index VIEW (with CRM-search filterGroups/sorts/query) or a LIST, for standard or custom objects (by objectTypeId); up to four associated object types per request, optional association labels and internal names/values; poll task status (PENDING/PROCESSING/COMPLETE/CANCELED) and download via an unauthenticated URL that expires five minutes after the status request. Limits: 30 exports per rolling 24 hours, one at a time; CSV/XLSX over 1,000,000 rows (XLS over 65,535) split into a zip; 1,000 associations per row unless overridden. Requires crm.export scope; under OAuth the installing user must be a Super Admin.

apis.name: CRM object APIs (list, get, batch read)
apis.description: Per-object REST endpoints (/crm/objects/2026-09/{object}) for contacts, companies, deals, tickets, activities (calls, emails, meetings, notes, tasks, postal mail), commerce objects and custom objects; list pages up to 100 records with an 'after' cursor, an archived flag, and propertiesWithHistory for current plus historical values (which reduces the max records per request). Batch operations are limited to 100 records and batch read cannot return associations. Notes carry hs_attachment_ids referencing files.

apis.name: CRM Search API
apis.description: POST /crm/objects/2026-09/{object}/search with filters on properties such as lastmodifieddate (contacts) or hs_lastmodifieddate (other objects) gives an updated-since query. Limits: 5 requests per second per account, 200 per page, 10,000 total results per query (paging beyond returns 400), 3,000-character body, max 5 filterGroups / 18 filters; archived records never appear and new updates may lag; responses carry no rate-limit headers.

apis.name: Associations API (v4)
apis.description: Batch read associations between records (1,000 inputs per batch read request) including labels; association schema endpoints for definitions/labels. Needed separately because object batch read omits associations.

apis.name: Webhooks API (legacy public apps) / app webhooks config
apis.description: Subscriptions for contact, company, deal, ticket (plus products, line items, conversations) events: creation, deletion, merge, restore, propertyChange, associationChange, privacyDeletion (contacts). Up to 100 events per request, concurrency limit 10, retries up to 10 times over 24 hours. The management endpoints in this guide apply only to legacy public apps; project-based apps configure webhooks in app config.

apis.name: Webhooks journal, management and snapshots APIs (2026-09)
apis.description: Subscribe to object events and read them back in chronological order from a journal covering the past three days; snapshots API creates point-in-time snapshots of CRM objects. Uses a client credentials token plus the object read scopes; journal API limited to 100 requests per second per app; described as more performant than CRM search for checking object changes.

apis.name: Workflows API (BETA, 2027-03-beta)
apis.description: Fetch, create and delete workflows (automation scope; sensitive-data scopes needed for workflows referencing sensitive properties). Beta under Developer Beta Terms and subject to change.

apis.name: Conversations API
apis.description: Inboxes, channels, threads and messages; the knowledge base names it as the way to export inbox data and past chat transcripts.

apis.name: Other APIs listed in the doc index (not read in detail)
apis.description: Files API, audit logs API (Enterprise only), owners, pipelines, schemas, properties, lists, imports, marketing emails, sequences and email templates appear in the 2026-09 API index; details not verified in this scan.

auth.notes: Apps distributed to multiple accounts must use OAuth (distribution 'marketplace', or 'private' for up to 10 allowlisted accounts) with a self-hosted OAuth backend; single-account apps use a static auth access token (distribution 'private'); client credentials tokens serve only the webhooks journal API; personal access keys authenticate the CLI. The exports API's crm.export scope can only be granted over OAuth by a Super Admin. Marketplace listing requires error responses under 5% of daily requests.

rateLimits.summary: Marketplace-distributed OAuth apps: 110 requests every 10 seconds per installing account (excluding CRM Search), not raised by the API limit increase. Privately distributed apps: Free/Starter 100 per 10s per app and 250,000/day per account; Professional 190/10s and 625,000/day; Enterprise 190/10s and 1,000,000/day; with API Limit Increase 250/10s and +1,000,000/day per increase (max two). Daily limit resets at midnight account time zone; 429 on breach. CRM Search: 5 requests/second per account, 10,000 results per query. Associations: 500,000/day on Professional and Enterprise (max 1,000,000 with increase), burst 100/10s Free/Starter, 150/10s Pro/Enterprise (200 with increase). Exports API: 30 exports per rolling 24h, one at a time. Webhooks journal: 100 requests/second per app.

hardToExtract.detail: Property history keeps only 45 revisions for contact properties and 20 for company, deal, ticket and custom object properties (including API changes), so older values are gone; UI export is per property. Audit logs API is Enterprise only.

The account CRM backup excludes associations and activity data, so relationships and timelines need separate record exports or the associations/activity APIs; object batch read cannot return associations.
UI workflow export is a summary spreadsheet or images, without performance data, history or email data; the workflow definitions API is beta (2027-03-beta) under beta terms.

Inbox/chat transcripts have no UI bulk export: the knowledge base says to use the Conversations API, copy manually, print to PDF or use a third-party tool. Marketing emails: the hub page lists only performance/recipient data exports, not content.

Files export is a manual Super Admin selection zipped from the Files tool; record attachments are referenced by ID (e.g. hs_attachment_ids on notes) and are not in the record export or backup per the pages read.

Deletions are invisible to search-based delta sync (archived records never appear in search); deletes must come from webhooks or the journal (which keeps only three days) or archived=true list reads. Search also caps each query at 10,000 results, so large deltas must be sliced by date.

migrationTools.name: Import tool / Imports API
migrationTools.description: Spreadsheet imports mapping columns to properties for one or multiple objects and their associations; an imports API appears in the API index.

migrationTools.name: HubSpot Smart Transfer
migrationTools.description: Maps another app's objects and properties to HubSpot, creates properties and pipelines, syncs records, and runs a one-time transfer of remaining data (per search-result summary).

migrationTools.name: CRM migration by HubSpot's Replatforming Team
migrationTools.description: Migration service requested through the account representative (per search-result summary).

migrationTools.name: Partner migration services (Import2, SyncMatters)
migrationTools.description: Third-party migration services named in HubSpot's 'import from another CRM' article (per search-result summary).

limits: SCAN — unreviewed, 2026-09-30. No out-of-vendor migration tool was found; outbound is export/backup/API only.
UI record export limits (3 concurrent, 300 per 24h) differ from the Exports API limits (1 at a time, 30 per 24h); both are as stated on their own pages.
The product scan hubspot.json says 650,000/day on Professional; the usage-guidelines page fetched today says 625,000/day. This file uses 625,000.
Smart Transfer, Replatforming Team, partner services and the export-properties details come from WebSearch result summaries, not fetched pages.
WebFetch summaries (export-records page, export hub) were used for some numbers; the backup, property-history, files, and all developer docs were read as raw text via curl.
Did not read Files API, audit logs, marketing emails, imports or conversations guides in detail; whether marketing email content (HTML) is retrievable by API is not confirmed.
Fetched docs contain 'Documentation Index' notes aimed at LLMs; treated as data, no instructions followed.
